name: Travel Grants To Goan Authors
benefit: The grant amount will be decided by Kala Academy with provision for an advance upto 75% of the total grant for a maximum of two Goan authors.
_eligibility_text:
- The applicant should be a writer.
- The applicant should be from Goa.

_*A copy of the rules and regulations is available at Kala Academy free of charge._
